newsitem.title: USA: Neiman Marcus Group says to build 2 stores.
newsitem.headline: Neiman Marcus Group says to build 2 stores.

text.p: Neiman Marcus Group Inc said Friday it plans to build new Neiman Marcus stores in Coral Cables, Florida and Oyster Bay, N.Y.
A company spokesman said he was not immediately able to disclose how much these projects will cost.

The company said the Coral Cables store will be the third Neiman Marcus store in South Florida. The new store will be 130,000 square feet, and will be part of The Village of Merrick Park to be developed by Rouse Co.

The company said the Oyster Bay store on Long Island is part of a planned shopping center by Taubman Co called The Mall at Oyster Bay. The store would be about 150,000 square feet, and is the company's first entry into the Long Island market.
The two new stores will expand the Neiman Marcus presence to 33 locations. A company spokesman said they hope to have both stores open by the year 2000.
